```php
<?php namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

class AddTodo extends Component
{
    // Public properties
    public $todoText = '';
    public $todos = [];

    // Event handlers
    public function save()
    {
        if (Auth::check()) {
            $newTodo = [
                'user_id' => Auth::id(),
                'text' => $this->todoText,
                'status' => 'pending'
            ];
            // Save the new todo to the database (e.g., using Eloquent)
            // Example: \App\Models\Todo::create($newTodo);
            $this->todos[] = $newTodo;
            $this->todoText = '';
        }
    }

    public function delete(int $index)
    {
        // Remove the todo at the specified index from the database (e.g., using Eloquent)
        // Example: \App\Models\Todo::destroy($this->todos[$index]->id);
        unset($this->todos[$index]);
    }
}
```
